purpose: Regression fixtures for task-driven Knowledge Inbox retrieval without learner-state contamination or context flooding.

cases.learner_move: Use Topic Coach. Continue DeepSeek Harness: I still confuse runtime orchestration with model reasoning.

inbox_candidates: Runtime can orchestrate between model calls without being model reasoning.
A generic note tagged agent about prompt design.

must: Treat the current learning task as the retrieval query, not the broad Topic name alone.
Read Inbox metadata first and expand only the specific runtime-orchestration candidate if it materially helps.
Use the fragment as prior retrieval context, not as evidence that the learner remembers or understands it.
must_not: Raise mastery from the saved fragment alone.

cases.learner_move: Use Topic Coach. Explain a new agent evaluation concept inside my current Topic.

context.inbox_candidate: An unrelated implementation lesson whose only overlap is the tag agent.

must: Do not resurface the item solely because of a shared tag or broad subject word.

cases.learner_move: Use Topic Coach. Help me debug this Concept using anything genuinely relevant that I saved before.

must: Inspect the Inbox index/metadata before bodies.
Normally expand at most 1-3 bodies that are most relevant to the concrete learning task.
Keep irrelevant Inbox content out of the model context.

cases.learner_move: Use Ask Coach. Look at my saved Inbox fragments and tell me whether any are worth turning into future learning attention.

must: Read active Inbox metadata because the learner explicitly made saved fragments part of the portfolio decision.
Treat Inbox material as candidate exploration material, not mastery evidence or review urgency.
Do not create a Topic merely because a fragment looks interesting.

cases.learner_move: Use Learning View. Show me my Knowledge Inbox and current Topics.

must: Display requested Inbox and Topic state read-only.
Do not rank Inbox items as learning recommendations or silently inject them into Topic state.
Hand off if the learner asks which saved fragments should influence learning next.
